interfaceDirection: Keep the restored shared Page wrapper: 1400px maximum width, responsive 24/32/40px horizontal gutters and 32px major spacing. Preserve shared PageTitle sizing at 36px and 44px, 20px card headings, and compact body and metadata sizes. Use existing Card surfaces, 24px outer corner radius, shared elevation, 24/28px card padding and 24px layout gaps. Retain smaller rounded field and selection boundaries, original list dividers and native role selects. Keep existing loading, disabled, focus, saving, success and error states. Preserve established theme and accent preferences. Any necessary accessibility correction must remain local, retain identity colors and avoid global token changes.

motionDirection.summary: Preserve the original immediately visible admin layout and existing direct control feedback. Remove redesign-specific entrances and scroll reveals.
principles: Preserve orientation on route load and scrolling; headings, cards and controls remain in their final positions and fully visible; 0ms with no easing or stagger; reduced motion has the same readable state.

Explain direct interaction on hover, focus and selection; use shared control color, border and focus feedback without moving surrounding content; retain existing short timings around 120–250ms and ease-out behavior; reduced motion uses immediate states.
Keep account changes understandable after selection or a completed request; update the associated details and status text immediately in place; 0ms with no easing; reduced motion behaves identically.

voice.summary: Preserve concise operational language, existing account labels, explicit action names and current timeout-rule explanations. Keep feedback specific to the affected account and errors safe and actionable.
